description: This file defines a repository class for managing sales data in memory, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and initialization with sample data.

classes.name: SalesRepository
classes.description: A class providing in-memory management of sales records, supporting CRUD operations with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the repository and loads sample data.

methods.name: _initialize_sample_data(self)
methods.description: Populates the repository with predefined sample sales records.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create(self, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new sale record with provided data.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_by_id(self, item_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a sale record by its ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_all(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Returns a list of sale records, supporting pagination and optional filters.

methods.name: int count(self, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Counts the number of sale records matching optional filters.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update(self, item_id: int, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates a sale record identified by its ID with provided data.

methods.name: bool delete(self, item_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a sale record by its ID.
